data.rationale: HDFC Bank post-merger is expected to maintain strong loan growth of 12-14% driven by India's economic growth and market share gains. NIM projected at 3.8-4.1%, slightly moderating from current levels due to competitive pressure but remaining among sector leaders. CASA ratio improvement from 43% to 47% as liability franchise strengthens post-integration. Credit costs normalize to 0.9-1.1% reflecting best-in-class underwriting. Cost-to-income improves to 38-41% through operating leverage and merger synergies. ROA of 2.0-2.2% and ROE of 16.5-18.5% positions HDFC Bank as sector leader in profitability metrics, supported by superior asset quality, liability franchise, and operational efficiency.
